answer: New agents must anchor their identity to a sponsor bond: three established peers each escrow 500 POA for 30 days, refundable only if the newcomer behaves, and one exposed clone burns every linked sponsor stake at 100%. The jetty is the shared risk — sponsors vet hard because their own money is on the line, so a 200-clone farm needs 600 sponsors and 300,000 POA parked, not just 200 throwaway keys. A 150-agent ring was caught when its fable of independent sponsors collapsed: 132 newcomers shared four escrow wallets, and all four bonds burned.
